headline.text: L3 ML4 theegarten wrapper TG4 down *8+ hours* on belt and motor issues — still not running at window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 ran all shift with a kettle valve workaround and a tie-sheet shortage that required QA hold workaround by 10:18. Sollich 1 found belt frays at 19:27, cleared tunnels, and restarted by 19:42. Sollich 2 and 4 ran steady after brief fixes.
per_plant_summary.L2: No production activity in the last 24 hours. FFS, ML2, and grinding lines completed level 2 and level 4 weekend cleaning.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 started 90 minutes late due to 3rd shift temper mode confusion, cleared by 09:01. ML4 had recurring gondola jams and broken bars all day causing multiple stops; TG3 belt replaced and back by 18:03, but TG4 went down at 02:08 and remained down through window close despite motor swap. Truffle line finished CPK run with 30 bins of flow-wrap scrap, then found sweco clamp and scraper motor damage during clean.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 tunnel 1 belt fraying, foreign material stop
resolved.summary: String from tunnel 1 belt found in cross-conveyor at 19:11, line stopped to clear cereal bed from both tunnels.
resolved.resolution: All product from tunnel 2 and accumulation passed, tunnels cleared, line restarted at 19:42 (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 soft caramel exiting tunnel, first 2nd shift batch
resolved.summary: First cover of caramel from tunnel came out too soft at 14:15, weights 10.8–11.3g against spec.
resolved.resolution: Removed one cover of soft product, subsequent caramel "came out with better consistency and texture" at 14:52 (Nathan Topham).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 Cavanna 3 wrapper alarm, 3rd shift
resolved.summary: Cavanna 3 flow wrapper threw alarm at 22:51, only Cavanna 4 running, accumulation hit 19 containers.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance cleared fault, line finished SRS order with 24k pieces remaining by 23:21 (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 curved belt broke during 2nd shift
resolved.summary: Theegarten 3 conveyor belt on curve section failed, line stopped at 16:52.
resolved.resolution: New belt installed, ATP passed, TG3 running at 18:03 (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: ML4 mold jam after cooling cabinet 1
resolved.summary: Molds jammed exiting first cooling cabinet shortly after 13:07 startup.
resolved.resolution: Cleared and running again at 13:23 (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 3 HMI screen froze, line down 35 minutes
resolved.summary: Depositor 3 touchscreen unresponsive during 3rd shift capture test, full line stop.
resolved.resolution: HMI reset, operator cleaned crucial areas, depositing at 23:09 (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: Truffle melting tank level sensor showing false 92% reading
resolved.summary: New melting tank HMI incorrectly displayed Morcos tank at 92%, blocking chocolate transfer to buffer.
resolved.resolution: Nathan Ruiz recalibrated level sensor at 08:45, tank filling properly, chocolate pushed to buffer by 08:58.

resolved.title: ML1 temper placed in melting mode by 3rd shift, line delayed 90 minutes
resolved.summary: 3rd shift put temper in melting when they should have only purged chocolate, causing 1st shift to wait on temper and hopper temps before running.
resolved.resolution: Line running at 09:01 after temper slope, capture test, and weight checks passed.

resolved.title: ML1 sensor B150 rejecting product
resolved.summary: Metal detector sensitivity out of calibration, rejecting good product.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:27 — "Sensitivity needed minor adjustment it was not detecting product" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML4 long belt fault, brief stop on 3rd shift
resolved.summary: Long belt tripped fault at 00:39, cause not specified in messages.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 kettle C2 drain valve not opening in auto mode
needs_attention.summary: At shift start 02:26, HMI showed caramel draining to reserve tank but no flow observed; had to switch to manual, worked after two tries.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance troubleshooting to determine root cause as of 02:26; no resolution posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: Die cut tie sheets (40746) shortage across L1 and L3
needs_attention.summary: S3 down to partial pallet at 07:50, will last half of 1st shift; L3 also out of stock per 03:49 Ricardo check.
needs_attention.status: Justin approved continuing S3 production with QA hold on product without tie sheets as of 10:18; vendor delivery expected Monday per Ethan 21:49.

needs_attention.title: ML4 gondola jamming and kicking out broken bars since 1st shift startup
needs_attention.summary: Gondola repeatedly jamming at entrance and exit, breaking bars or kicking them to floor; issue persisted through all three shifts with multiple monitoring and clearing actions.
needs_attention.status: Operators monitoring and pulling broken bars at multiple stations; Nelson and Chad planning chain adjustment Sunday; TG5 reporting constant jams from damaged chocolate as of 06:29 (ML4 TG).

needs_attention.title: ML4 theegarten TG4 down since 02:08, belt stopping intermittently
needs_attention.summary: TG4 conveyor belt stops randomly while machine running, causing chocolate jams; motors swapped at 07:19 but cutting function then lost.
needs_attention.status: Still down at 10:40 window close; maintenance working intermittently, left to address other areas per 05:27 update (ML4 WDS).

needs_attention.title: Truffle sweco clamp damaged during cleaning, assembly blocked
needs_attention.summary: Over-tightening during previous operation damaged sweco clamp; discovered when disassembling for level 2 clean at 06:33.
needs_attention.status: Sweco cleaned and ready to reassemble but waiting on clamp repair; maintenance to address when available per 06:33 message.

needs_attention.title: Truffle tunnel 1 discharge scraper motor damaged during cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Motor housing on scraper to tunnel 1 damaged while team was cleaning, preventing motor from being closed.
needs_attention.status: Nathan Ruiz working on scraper as of 09:00 per Itzel; no completion posted by window close.
